facts.text: I am considering buying a fitness tracker for my friend's birthday.
I recently got a Samsung smartwatch, a Galaxy Watch Active2.
I bought the Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2 on February 10th from Best Buy.
My budget for the gift is around $200.
I like the features of my Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2, especially sleep tracking and heart rate tracking.
I want a fitness tracker with water resistance as a nice feature.
I think the Fitbit Inspire HR sounds like a great option.
I want to know whether the Fitbit Inspire HR sleep tracking tracks REM sleep and provides detailed sleep insights like my Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2.
I am now considering purchasing the Fitbit Inspire HR from Amazon.
I recently got a great deal on my Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2.
I bought the Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2 on February 10th from Best Buy.
The Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2 was on sale for $200.
The sale price of the Samsung Galaxy Watch Active2 was $50 less than the usual price.
I will check out Best Buy's website and store for any bundle deals on the Fitbit Inspire HR.

keyphrases: Fitbit Inspire HR Amazon bundle deals
